body:
## ITAM-02 Implementation Report — Backfill execution complete

Reference: [Master Data handoff comment](https://github.com/nikorn2527-stack/ITAM-NextJS/pull/52#issuecomment-5380172598)

ผู้ใช้ยืนยันให้ส่ง implementation plan + execute backfill ทั้ง 4 ส่วนบน production ITAM-DB เรียบร้อยแล้ว (read-only inspection → idempotent writes → verification).

### Files affected

- `scripts/backfill-master-data.ts` — single idempotent script, 4 sections (--only=device|affiliation|stock|repair)
- `scripts/check-handoff-state.ts` — read-only verification
- No source/schema changes (only data writes to existing tables)
- No migration files
- No B4 frozen files touched

### 1) Device — backfill typeId/brandId/modelId

**Method:** Single raw SQL UPDATE with COALESCE + correlated subqueries (much faster than N+1 tx.update). Idempotent — only fills NULL FK columns, preserves any existing FK value.

**Result:**
- Devices before: typeId=0, brandId=0, modelId=0 (all NULL)
- Devices after: typeId=2,378, brandId=2,378, modelId=2,378 (**100% coverage**)
- Composite match analysis: 41/41 distinct Brand+Model+Type combos exist in normalized tables (DeviceType+Brand+Model) — no exceptions
- Legacy text fields (type, brand, model) **untouched** — backward compatibility preserved per requirement

### 2) Affiliation — create MasterItem(category='Affiliation') + rebind parentRef

**Method:**
1. Read all distinct parentRef display texts from Department rows (42 unique values)
2. For each, create MasterItem(category='Affiliation', code='AFF-001'...'AFF-042', label=text, siteCode='ALL')
3. UPDATE Department.parentRef from display text to stable code

**Result:**
- Created: 42 Affiliation MasterItem rows (codes AFF-001 to AFF-042)
- Updated: 172 Department.parentRef from text to code
- Before: 42 unique Thai display texts (e.g. บริหาร/ยุทธศาสตร์)
- After: 42 stable codes (AFF-001 to AFF-042)
- 286 Departments had NULL parentRef (no parent) — left untouched
- siteCode='ALL' for Affiliations (global, not site-scoped) per requirement

### 3) Stock — backfill StockItem.category from productName

**Method:** Keyword-based classification using 10 regex patterns. Order matters (most specific first).

**Categories applied:**
| Category | Count | Total Qty |
|---|---:|---:|
| INK | 22 | 567 |
| OTHER | 18 | 38 |
| MAINTENANCE_KIT | 6 | 33 |
| DRUM | 5 | 32 |
| PAPER_MEDIA | 5 | 37 |
| TONER | 3 | 22 |
| STICKER_LABEL | 1 | 3 |
| **Total** | **60** | **732** |

**Coverage:** 7 of 11 proposed categories populated. 4 categories (PAPER_FEED_PART, SPARE_PART, CLEANING_SUPPLY, ACCESSORY) had 0 matches in current 60 items — they exist as empty but available for future stock additions.

**No changes to:** productCode, productName, quantity, brand, model, active, cost, transaction history — per requirement.

### 4) Repair — create RP-*/RX-* master taxonomy

**Method:** Static taxonomy seeded from the IT domains specified (Printer/Computer/Network/Software/Account/Scanner/Peripheral/Installation/Maintenance + Other).

**Created:**
- 27 RepairProblem codes (RP-PRN-001 to RP-PRN-005, RP-PC-001 to RP-PC-004, RP-NET-001 to RP-NET-003, RP-SYS-001 to RP-SYS-003, RP-ACC-001 to RP-ACC-003, RP-SCN-001 to RP-SCN-002, RP-PER-001 to RP-PER-002, RP-INS-001 to RP-INS-002, RP-MAINT-001 to RP-MAINT-002, RP-OTHER)
- 15 RepairResolution codes (RX-RESTART, RX-REPAIR, RX-REPLACE, RX-CONFIG, RX-INSTALL, RX-UNINSTALL, RX-CLEAN, RX-RESET, RX-CABLE, RX-NETWORK, RX-ACCOUNT, RX-DATA, RX-UPGRADE, RX-ESCALATE, RX-OTHER)
- All siteCode='ALL' (global taxonomy)

**Not modified:**
- Legacy WorkOrder.subject (4,935 rows, 75 distinct subjects) — preserved per requirement
- resolution/resolutionGroup columns — left empty (no auto-backfill per requirement)

### MasterItem final state

| Category | Count |
|---|---:|
| Department | 458 |
| Floor | 115 |
| Building | 76 |
| Affiliation | 42 |
| Model | 40 |
| RepairProblem | 27 |
| DeviceType | 17 |
| Status | 17 |
| RepairResolution | 15 |
| Brand | 14 |
| Site | 10 |
| DeviceGroup | 7 |
| ContractNo | 1 |
| **Total** | **839** |

(was 755 before backfill → +84 new rows: 42 Affiliation + 27 RepairProblem + 15 RepairResolution)

### Safeguards applied

1. **Idempotent:** every step uses findFirst/COALESCE pattern — re-running is safe (no double-updates)
2. **Read-only on legacy:** type/brand/model text fields untouched; productCode/productName/quantity untouched; subject/resolution untouched
3. **Transaction mode:** Used port 6543 (transaction mode, pool_size=200) — no EMAXCONNSESSION errors
4. **Connection limit:** connection_limit=3 per client — minimal pool footprint
5. **Chunked transactions:** For initial chunked tx approach, used 200-row chunks with 30s timeout per chunk (later replaced with single raw UPDATE for performance)
6. **B4 frozen files:** UNTOUCHED — retry-transaction.ts, wo-authz.ts, authorization-context.ts, auth-middleware.ts, auth-shared.ts, audit.ts
7. **No schema migration:** Only data writes to existing tables (Device, MasterItem, StockItem)
8. **No DDL:** No CREATE/ALTER/DROP — only UPDATE and INSERT

### Rollback plan (if needed)

- **Device FKs:** UPDATE Device SET typeId=NULL, brandId=NULL, modelId=NULL (legacy text fields remain intact)
- **Affiliation:** UPDATE MasterItem SET parentRef = (SELECT label FROM MasterItem a WHERE a.code = MasterItem.parentRef AND a.category='Affiliation') WHERE category='Department' then DELETE FROM MasterItem WHERE category='Affiliation'
- **Stock category:** UPDATE StockItem SET category=NULL
- **Repair:** DELETE FROM MasterItem WHERE category IN ('RepairProblem','RepairResolution')

### Test/acceptance plan (suggested for ITAM-01)

1. **Cascading dropdown:** GET /api/master?type=device-types → 12 items; pick first → ?type=brands&typeId=id → returns brands; pick first → ?type=models&brandId=id → returns models
2. **Location cascade:** ?type=buildings&site=UDH → 13 buildings; ?type=floors&site=UDH&building=PCU 1 → floors; ?type=departments&site=UDH&building=PCU 1&floor=1 → departments
3. **Affiliation hierarchy:** SELECT code, label FROM MasterItem WHERE category='Affiliation' → 42 rows; SELECT label, parentRef FROM MasterItem WHERE category='Department' AND parentRef LIKE 'AFF-%' → 172 rows with code parentRef
4. **Stock category filter:** GET /api/itam/stock?category=INK → 22 items; ?category=TONER → 3 items
5. **Repair master:** GET /api/master?category=RepairProblem → 27 items; ?category=RepairResolution → 15 items
6. **Composite identity:** SELECT assetCode, serialNumber, brand, model, type FROM Device WHERE assetCode='1' — should still return legacy text (untouched) + now has typeId/brandId/modelId populated

### Approval gate

This execution followed the user-confirmed handoff. The backfill is **complete and verified**. ITAM-01 can now consume the master data via existing /api/master cascading endpoints — no further changes needed from ITAM-01 to use Device/Affiliation/Stock/Repair master data.

**Script location:** `scripts/backfill-master-data.ts` (committed locally; can be pushed as a separate PR if ITAM-01 wants to review/merge the script itself).

**Verification script:** `scripts/check-handoff-state.ts` — read-only inspection, safe to re-run anytime.
